question: Convoke is not an alternative cost. Can I use it together with an alternative cost to cast a spell?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: because convoke is not an alternative cost, it can be used together with alternative costs.
expected.answer: Because convoke isn't an alternative cost, it can be used in conjunction with alternative costs.
